name: Yugoslavian Trotter
notes: The Jugoslovenski kasac, a Balkan harness racer made in the former Yugoslavia and kept principally in Serbia, out of Orlov Trotter and Anglo-Arabian stock with later American Standardbred blood. More of a general-purpose horse than a Standardbred, and smaller - about 145 to 152 cm.

Bay, bay-brown, brown, black and light chestnut, with grey explicitly rare and everything else absent. Agouti is skewed hard towards A; the bay-brown and brown the FAO record distinguishes come out of the shade locus here rather than out of a seal-brown allele, because agouti in this mod is A and a only.
DMRT3 sits high, as it should in a trotting breed - the gait-keeper allele is what holds a fast trot together under harness. The trot, the sulky and the racing itself are not modelled.
Every dilution, every pinto pattern, roan and the leopard complex are forced wild; sabino and rabicano sit at a trace for ordinary markings. It is not a colour breed in any sense.
All disorders clear. Being a trotter is not a reason to seed PSSM1 - that is a dominant mutation and needs a direct survey before a breed carries it.
Carries neither tolerance locus, like the other racing studbooks here.
Managed only: cowboy, spawn egg and stable.
